Election Commission Limits Form-7 Objections to 10 Per Person

The Election Commission of India has introduced a new rule limiting individuals to submitting a maximum of 10 applications on Form-7. Form-7 is used to request the removal of a voter's name from electoral rolls. This update aims to streamline the process and prevent misuse.
